22: // NewEmailService creates a new email service

24: 	cfg := config.GetConfig()
25: 
26: 	return &EmailService{
27: 		smtpHost:     cfg.Email.SMTPHost,
28: 		smtpPort:     cfg.Email.SMTPPort,
29: 		smtpUser:     cfg.Email.SMTPUser,
30: 		smtpPassword: cfg.Email.SMTPPassword,
31: 		fromEmail:    cfg.Email.FromEmail,
32: 		fromName:     cfg.Email.FromName,
33: 	}
34: }
35: 
36: // SendEmail sends an email
37: func (es *EmailService) SendEmail(to, subject, body string, isHTML bool) error {
38: 	// Build email headers
39: 	headers := make(map[string]string)
40: 	headers["From"] = es.formatAddress(es.fromName, es.fromEmail)
41: 	headers["To"] = to
42: 	headers["Subject"] = subject
43: 	headers["MIME-Version"] = "1.0"
44: 
45: 	if isHTML {
46: 		headers["Content-Type"] = "text/html; charset=UTF-8"
47: 	} else {
48: 		headers["Content-Type"] = "text/plain; charset=UTF-8"
49: 	}
50: 
51: 	// Build email message
52: 	var message bytes.Buffer
53: 	for key, value := range headers {
54: 		message.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s\r\n", key, value))
55: 	}
56: 	message.WriteString("\r\n")
57: 	message.WriteString(body)
58: 
59: 	// Connect to SMTP server
60: 	auth := smtp.PlainAuth("", es.smtpUser, es.smtpPassword, es.smtpHost)
61: 	addr := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", es.smtpHost, es.smtpPort)
62: 
63: 	// Send email
64: 	err := smtp.SendMail(addr, auth, es.fromEmail, []string{to}, message.Bytes())
65: 	if err != nil {
66: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to send email: %w", err)
67: 	}
68: 
69: 	return nil
70: }
71:

73: func (es *EmailService) formatAddress(name, email string) string {
74: 	if name != "" {
75: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%s <%s>", name, email)
76: 	}
77: 	return email
78: }
79:

464: // LoadWithDefaults loads configuration with default values
465: func LoadWithDefaults() (*Config, error) {
466: 	// Load .env file if it exists (for API keys and other environment variables)
467: 	// Try multiple locations: current directory, parent directory
468: 	envPaths := []string{".env", "../.env"}
469: 	for _, envPath := range envPaths {
470: 		if err := gotenv.Load(envPath); err == nil {
471: 			break // Successfully loaded .env file
472: 		}
473: 		// Continue trying other paths if this one fails
474: 	}
475: 
476: 	// Set default values
477: 	setDefaults()
478: 
479: 	// Respect an explicitly requested config file first. This is how the wrapper
480: 	// forces the backend to use development/testnet configs instead of falling
481: 	// back to the production search path.
482: 	if explicitConfig := os.Getenv("KNIRV_CONFIG_FILE"); explicitConfig != "" {
483: 		viper.SetConfigFile(explicitConfig)
484: 	} else {
485: 		// Set configuration file name and paths
486: 		viper.SetConfigName("production")
487: 		viper.SetConfigType("yaml")
488: 		viper.AddConfigPath("./config")
489: 		viper.AddConfigPath(".")
490: 
491: 		// Also check the canonical extracted config directory (~/.config/knirv-server/config).
492: 		if configDir, err := GetConfigDir(); err == nil {
493: 			viper.AddConfigPath(filepath.Join(configDir, "config"))
494: 		}
495: 	}
496: 
497: 	// Environment variable support — replace dots with underscores so that
498: 	// nested keys like "gateway.binary_path" map to KNIRV_GATEWAY_BINARY_PATH.
499: 	viper.SetEnvPrefix("KNIRV")
500: 	viper.SetEnvKeyReplacer(strings.NewReplacer(".", "_"))
501: 	viper.AutomaticEnv()
502: 	_ = viper.BindEnv("api.socket_path", "KNIRV_API_SOCKET", "KNIRV_API_SOCKET_PATH")
503: 
504: 	// Read configuration file (optional)
505: 	if err := viper.ReadInConfig(); err != nil {
506: 		if _, ok := err.(viper.ConfigFileNotFoundError); !ok {
507: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read config file: %w", err)
508: 		}
509: 		// Config file not found, continue with environment variables and defaults
510: 	}
511: 
512: 	var config Config
513: 	if err := viper.Unmarshal(&config); err != nil {
514: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal config: %w", err)
515: 	}
516: 
517: 	// Expand all paths in configuration
518: 	if err := config.ExpandPaths(); err != nil {
519: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to expand paths: %w", err)
520: 	}
521: 
522: 	// Validate configuration
523: 	if err := validateConfig(&config); err != nil {
524: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid configuration: %w", err)
525: 	}
526: 
527: 	return &config, nil
528: }

546: // expandPath expands paths with ~ to the user's home directory and creates them if needed
547: // Relative paths are resolved relative to the application data directory, NOT the current working directory
548: func expandPath(path string) (string, error) {
549: 	if strings.HasPrefix(path, "~") {
550: 		usr, err := user.Current()
551: 		if err != nil {
552: 			return "", err
553: 		}
554: 		var expanded string
555: 		if len(path) > 1 && (path[1] == '/' || path[1] == '\\') {
556: 			expanded = filepath.Join(usr.HomeDir, path[2:])
557: 		} else {
558: 			expanded = filepath.Join(usr.HomeDir, path[1:])
559: 		}
560: 		return expanded, nil
561: 	}
562: 
563: 	// Resolve relative paths relative to the application data directory (XDG Base)
564: 	if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
565: 		appDataDir, err := getAppDataDir()
566: 		if err != nil {
567: 			// Fallback to CWD absolute path only if we can't get app data directory
568: 			absPath, errAbs := filepath.Abs(path)
569: 			if errAbs != nil {
570: 				return path, nil
571: 			}
572: 			return absPath, nil
573: 		}
574: 		return filepath.Join(appDataDir, path), nil
575: 	}
576: 
577: 	return path, nil
578: }

426: // RecordLoginAttempt records a login attempt and handles account locking
427: func (us *UserService) RecordLoginAttempt(username string, ipAddress string, success bool) error {
428: 	user, err := us.GetUserByUsername(username)
429: 	if err != nil {
430: 		// User not found, still record the attempt for rate limiting
431: 		return us.recordRateLimitAttempt(username, ipAddress, success)
432: 	}
433: 
434: 	if success {
435: 		// Successful login
436: 		now := time.Now()
437: 		user.LastLoginAt = &now
438: 		user.LoginAttempts = 0
439: 		user.LockedUntil = nil
440: 		user.UpdatedAt = time.Now()
441: 
442: 		if err := us.db.StoreJSON(fmt.Sprintf("users:profiles:%s", user.ID), user); err != nil {
443: 			log.Printf("Failed to update last login: %v", err)
444: 		}
445: 	} else {
446: 		// Failed login
447: 		user.LoginAttempts++
448: 		user.UpdatedAt = time.Now()
449: 
450: 		// Lock account after 5 failed attempts
451: 		if user.LoginAttempts >= 5 {
452: 			lockUntil := time.Now().Add(30 * time.Minute)
453: 			user.LockedUntil = &lockUntil
454: 		}
455: 
456: 		if err := us.db.StoreJSON(fmt.Sprintf("users:profiles:%s", user.ID), user); err != nil {
457: 			log.Printf("Failed to update login attempts: %v", err)
458: 		}
459: 	}
460: 
461: 	return us.recordRateLimitAttempt(username, ipAddress, success)
462: }

464: // AuthenticateUser authenticates a user with username/password
465: func (us *UserService) AuthenticateUser(username, password, ipAddress string) (*objects.User, error) {
466: 	// Check rate limiting first
467: 	if locked, err := us.isRateLimited(username, ipAddress); err != nil {
468: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("rate limit check failed: %w", err)
469: 	} else if locked {
470: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("too many login attempts, please try again later")
471: 	}
472: 
473: 	// Get user
474: 	user, err := us.GetUserByUsername(username)
475: 	if err != nil {
476: 		// Record failed attempt
477: 		us.RecordLoginAttempt(username, ipAddress, false)
478: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid credentials")
479: 	}
480: 
481: 	// Check if account can login
482: 	if !user.CanLogin() {
483: 		us.RecordLoginAttempt(username, ipAddress, false)
484: 		if user.IsLocked() {
485: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("account is temporarily locked due to too many failed login attempts")
486: 		}
487: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("account is not active")
488: 	}
489: 
490: 	// Verify password
491: 	if !objects.VerifyPassword(password, user.PasswordHash, user.Salt) {
492: 		us.RecordLoginAttempt(username, ipAddress, false)
493: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid credentials")
494: 	}
495: 
496: 	// Successful authentication
497: 	us.RecordLoginAttempt(username, ipAddress, true)
498: 
499: 	// Log audit event
500: 	us.logAuditEvent(user.ID, "login", "user", user.ID, ipAddress, "", "User login successful", true)
501: 
502: 	return user, nil
503: }

609: 	}
